messages:
Iris V: Hi @people-ops  confidentially flagging an issue: I've had worsening vestibular symptoms (dizziness) after long stretches of code review and back-to-back screens. It's making it hard to keep up with our fast review cadence and I missed an SLA yesterday. Could we talk about temporary accommodations: fewer consecutive review hours, shorter meeting windows, screen tinting tools, and maybe a modified review quota for 4 weeks? Please keep this private.

Noah (People Ops): Thanks for telling us, Iris  really sorry you're dealing with this. We can absolutely help. Quick Qs: do you want to request a reduced review quota + meeting limits, trial of screen filter hardware/software, or some WFH/flexible hours to space reviews? I can DM the confidential intake form and open a case.

Iris V: Reduced review quota + meeting limits would be most helpful right now. Screen filter software might help00please add as backup. Prefer manager + People Ops only.

PeopleOpsBot: :white_check_mark: Case created: AC-2026-7423. Noah assigned.

Sam (Eng Manager): Iris  I support this. I can temporarily reassign some review batches and reduce your reviewer throughput targets for 4 weeks. I'll cover urgent reviews and let the team know "temporary review load adjustment" without medical detail. No problem on privacy.

Eileen (Accessibility): We have a licensed software (f.lux style) and a clip-on screen filter we can ship next-day. Also low-contrast themes and larger font prefs can reduce vestibular triggers. Happy to set up a short trial and help apply settings.

Noah (People Ops): DM sent with secure intake: https://redwood.hr/accom-intake (private). Process: 1) short intake form, 2) manager acknowledgement (redacted), 3) interim accommodations (often same day), 4) case logged confidentially. We'll propose: a) 50% review quota for 4 weeks, b) no >90min consecutive review blocks, c) screen filter shipped, d) meetings capped at 45min and defaulted to optional camera-off. Does that sound right?

Iris V: Yes00that list looks good. Please prioritize the quota reduction and meeting caps. Ship the clip-on filter as backup. Thank you.

PeopleOpsBot: Update: AC-2026-7423 interim accommodations logged = review quota 50% for 4 weeks, cap review blocks to 90min, meeting length cap 45min (camera optional), screen-filter request pending. Manager notification to be redacted to "temporary workload and meeting accommodation approved."

Sam (Eng Manager): I've updated reviewer assignment rules and added a flag on urgent PRs so I can triage. I'll also add an exclusion for yesterday's missed SLA in the performance tracker.

Eileen (Accessibility): Ordering clip-on filter now and sending software setup steps via DM. If Iris wants, I can do a 20min setup call (camera optional) to configure high-contrast and reduced-motion prefs.

Iris V: Please do the setup call  20min sounds good and camera optional is appreciated. Thank you all for acting quickly and keeping this private.

Noah (People Ops): Noted. Follow-up check scheduled in 7 days to reassess AC-2026-7423. If you need an extension or formal accommodation plan, we can convert this to a longer-term ADA accommodation.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 7 days for case AC-2026-7423.
